coordinationCeiling: This mechanism does not detect separately controlled accounts acting in coordination, credential farms, or sequential credential cycling.
protectedActionOrResource: Binding one active credential identifier to no more than one active local account.

stateRetention.deletionMechanism: Revoke or delete the credential binding when the credential is revoked, the account is deleted, or the documented credential-retention period expires.

defenderCostCeiling: One transactional credential-binding lookup and insert per registration or credential-addition ceremony; no human review queue and no cross-account graph computation.
remediationLatencyTarget: Credential conflicts reject immediately during the active registration or credential-addition ceremony.
appealServiceLevelTarget: A member may use credential recovery or request account-access support without disclosure of any conflicting account. An acknowledgment target is one business day.
accessibilityAlternative: Members may register a different compatible passkey or use the established recovery path. No hardware class, biometric, camera, location, identity document, phone number, or payment instrument is required.
residualRiskStatement: The constraint prevents one active credential ID from being simultaneously bound to more than one local account. It does not prove one person per account, prevent new credentials, prevent shared credentials, identify coordinated campaigns, detect device farms, or stop sequential account creation.
